title: Connected TV Advertising: What It Is and Why It Matters

facts.fact: Industry benchmarks, as cited by Teads, show CTV ads achieve 95%+ completion rates, compared with 20-40% on YouTube and under 30% on social video.
facts.quote: Industry benchmarks show CTV ads achieve 95%+ completion rates compared to 20-40% on YouTube and under 30% on social video.

facts.fact: Teads states that 61% of households are subscribed to multiple streaming services, citing IAB Compass.
facts.quote: With 61% of households subscribed to multiple streaming services (IAB Compass)

facts.fact: Teads reports that 64% of marketers use first-party data for CTV targeting.
facts.quote: Today, 64% of marketers use first-party data for CTV targeting, while 60% apply behavioral or intent-based signals.

facts.fact: Teads reports that 60% of marketers apply behavioral or intent-based signals for CTV targeting.
facts.quote: while 60% apply behavioral or intent-based signals.

facts.fact: Teads reports that 50% of marketers cite audience targeting inefficiencies as their top CTV challenge.
facts.quote: 50% of marketers cite audience targeting inefficiencies as their top CTV challenge.

facts.fact: In Teads' 2025 CTV Pulse report, 24% of 18-24 year olds say they will scan a QR code from a CTV ad.
facts.quote: 18-24 year olds: 24% will scan a QR code, 15% will add products to a cart directly from an ad

facts.fact: In Teads' 2025 CTV Pulse report, 15% of 18-24 year olds say they will add products to a cart directly from a CTV ad.

facts.fact: EMARKETER reports that 71% of net new streaming subscriptions over the past nine quarters have been ad-supported.

facts.fact: Teads states that half of large companies (250+ employees) now always include CTV in their marketing strategy, compared with 6-7% of small businesses.
facts.quote: Half of large companies (250+ employees) now always include CTV in their marketing strategy, compared to just 6-7% of small businesses.
